topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 43 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 10 common project-authored base contract(s) (peripheryimmutablestate, peripheryvalidation, blocktimestamp). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
